description: List live crypto trading signals that are still open — coin, direction, confidence and the reasoning behind each. Use it to find current trade ideas; use get_signal for one signal by ID (live or resolved), get_signal_history for signals that already closed, and get_stats for aggregate hit rate. No key: a 3-signal preview. Free key: up to 100 signals, with entry, stop-loss, take-profit and leverage null (the response's announcement.upgradeUrl explains Pro). Pro: all levels. Returns { signals[], returned, totalMatching, filtersApplied, plan }, sorted by live PnL (best first). Optional filters narrow the list: direction, coins, confidence band, risk/reward, stop distance, open interest, 24h volume, tags, the anomaly that triggered it, days/hours to skip, a BTC 24h-return gate. Rate limits: 30 calls/hour per IP without a key, 300/hour on a free key.

apiKey.description: Optional. Your Signals API key. Omit it for a 3-signal anonymous preview; get a free key at https://signals.x70.ai/mcp-signup for full metadata.

btcRet24hMax.description: Skip if BTC 24h return % > this (e.g. 1.5). H1 regime gate: BTC rally rotates flow away from alts.

coin.description: Single coin symbol (e.g. BTC). Case-insensitive. Convenience alias for coinInclude=<coin>.

coinExclude.description: Comma-separated coin blocklist. Hyper-blacklist used by Lean v2-R: "kPEPE,ADA,HYPER,LDO,LINEA,2Z".

coinOiMax.description: Maximum open interest in USD. R13 uses $500k-$10M.

coinOiMin.description: Minimum open interest in USD (e.g. 500000 for $500k). OI <$500k coins historically toxic.

days.description: Lookback window in days (1–30, default 7). Without a key or on the free plan only the last 24 hours are searched.

direction.description: Filter by signal direction. "bullish" = long. Default = any.

primaryTrigger.description: Sentinel anomaly trigger name (e.g. "vpin_toxicity" for the S9 Vpin Sniper preset).

riskRewardRatioMax.description: Maximum risk/reward ratio. Champion v1 uses RR<1.5.

skipDOW.description: Comma-separated day names to skip (e.g. "Saturday,Sunday"). Mondays toxic, weekends weak.

skipHourUtc.description: Comma-separated hours UTC to skip (0..23). EU/US overlap 9-13 weakest.

slDistPctMin.description: Minimum stop-loss distance in % (e.g. 3 = ≥3% to SL). SL≥3 drops the toxic [2,3) bucket.

name: get_signals
title: Get Live Trading Signals
